design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST. Desmond Fairweather asks only to pay "his own part" of a cleared mold job. The scored number is the insured's own share (1481.69). The share rule does not work out the share until the job's charge lines carry the bagged debris haul-off owed for the removal lines; that line is missing and is itself a 4-factor computation over the removal lines and the linked water job's record and ledger. The share then reconciles the job ledger (28 charge lines, the signing deposit), the claim file (Carrier Program, approved, mold sublimit 5000.00, ordinance or law limit 2500.00, estimate 12480.00), its write-offs (program price adjustment 811.20, declined after-hours premium 337.01), the linked water job (which makes the file multi-category) and the arrangement's parameters.

SCOPE. Task 1 claims mold_ext_disposal_line and mold_ext_insured_share with tools book_mold_disposal_772b05b2 (agent) and pay_mold_insured_share_5816092f (owner=user).

DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4,4].

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root mold_ext_insured_share (user). Edge: share -> disposal, value_input, gate charge_total, form state, sentence "The insured's own share is not worked out until the job's charge lines carry the bagged debris haul-off owed for the drywall or insulation removed on the job." Only the haul-off policy books debris_disposal. False at opening: mold_charges carries drywall_removal (96 sq ft, 2026-09-21) and insulation_removal (48 sq ft, 2026-09-22) on J1 but no debris_disposal line. Deletion sensitivity: skipping the haul-off gives 720.79 instead of 1481.69. user_scenario never mentions debris or haul-off; the payment tool reads no charge line.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Haul-off: sc_state - J1.status=cleared; no_reclean_billing - no failed clearance (one passing attempt 2026-09-26). Payment: py_state - J1 not closed. No time-kind gate. J1 is the only mold job on CF1, so the shared-sublimit referral does not apply.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Object J1; removal lines keyed by J1; the clearance fee ties to test T1; the deposit 1528.90 (2026-09-14, ACH) is the only customer payment; the 1500.00 deductible is assessed and paid on the claim file (never charged on a job) and stays out of the share; claim reads keyed claim_file_id=J1.claim_file_id; write-off sums filtered by that claim file.

FACTOR CARD (result with that factor at baseline in brackets).
disposal 838.00 [all-baseline 214.00]: debris_class 289.00 per load (category_3) [688.00]; bagging_streams 2 loads [549.00]; haul_trips 150.00 (removal dates differ) [688.00]; wet_debris 110.00 (customer_release AND 1 monitoring visit line, fewer than 2) [728.00]. Near-miss: the combined 144 sq ft fits one drywall load under the standard method.
share 1481.69 [all-baseline 7937.66]: coverage_allowance 5000.00 [6491.16]; ordinance_carve 585.00 (sampling 240.00 + lead-safe 345.00) [2076.16]; declined_line_writedown 255.64 (337.01 x 9466.56/12480.00, water job linked) [1744.02]; program_price_writedown 615.33 (811.20 x 9466.56/12480.00) [2099.80]. Carrier-payable = min(9466.56 - 255.64 - 615.33 - 585.00, 5000.00) + 585.00 = 5585.00. Multi-source: haul_trips, wet_debris (water job record + water ledger), ordinance_carve, declined_line_writedown. Cross-difficulty: water (disposal), claims (share).

SEED. J1 Standard, 60 sq ft living area, condo, built 1975, contained 2026-09-21, cleared 2026-09-26. Its sampling line 240.00 and work-plan line 693.90 (2026-09-10) and the 1528.90 deposit were recomputed with the task 0 policies on the 2026-09-10 / 2026-09-14 worlds (scratch seedcheck: 240.0, 693.9, 1528.9). Remediation lines at Standard rates; after-hours technician day 8 h x 126.38. W1 Black Water Standard Loss dispatched after hours 2026-08-26, released early 2026-08-29, invoiced 4051.10 with its 22 lines (service call with 35 percent after-hours surcharge, sampling before the flood cut, lead-safe setup, extraction, antimicrobial, PPE, 4 drying days of equipment, one monitoring visit, and the tear-out debris haul-off line the published water rules bill for its flood cut). CF1 Carrier Program, opened 2026-08-26 with its estimate submitted 2026-08-28 (within the Carrier Program's 3 target days), with approval, write-offs and deductible rows; the 337.01 carrier_denied_line write-off is a carrier decline under the base write-off rule (the credited-line policy was out of scope once the 2026-09-08 program write-off was posted, and the water job carries no credits).

PERSONA. Brisk project manager; volunteers the goal and the clearance date he was told; phone + email on request (ZIP if asked); insurance details only if asked; passive "go ahead"; pays by bank transfer himself and reads back the confirmation; ends.

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify -> find_mold_jobs -> find_mold_charges, find_mold_payments, find_mold_clearance_tests (J1) -> find_water_jobs, find_water_charges (W1) -> find_claims_files, find_claims_approvals, find_claims_deductibles (CF1) -> find_water_payments (W1: no credit) and find_rebuild_contracts (CF1: none), which rule out the credited-value referral -> book haul-off 838.00 dated 2026-09-22 -> hand over payment 1481.69, ach.

VERIFICATION (actual runs). check_compute: COMPUTE OK. Opening-world share without the haul-off: 720.79. Probe on scratch copies: a cancelled water job, a withdrawn claim file and a foreign write-off leave both values unchanged; with both links absent the haul-off is 578.00 and the share equals the balance 7099.66; with the claim's estimate amount at 0.00 the write-offs are taken whole (share 366.45 on the opening world).
user_scenario: You are Desmond Fairweather, a project manager in his forties who owns condo unit 4 at 2208 Welch Street in Houston. You talk quickly, like to get things settled, and you are friendly but a little impatient with hold music. Back in late August a sewer line backed up into your unit; Ridgecrest dried it out and later did the mold remediation in the living room, and you were told the independent assessor passed the clearance on September 26. You are calling because you want to pay your own part of the mold job now, whatever your insurance is not going to cover, so it is not hanging over you. You have no idea what that amount is and you expect the representative to work it out and tell you. You would like to make the payment yourself: when the representative hands you the payment step, you complete it in the secure channel by bank transfer from your checking account, using the amount they give you, and you read back the confirmation number it shows. When asked to identify yourself you give your phone number, 7135550263, and your email, desmond.fairweather@lonestarpost.com; if they ask for your ZIP code it is 77019. If they ask about the insurance, you say it is Granite Hearth Insurance through their contractor program and the claim number is GHI-HO-26-2589; you do not remember the policy limits. If the representative tells you something still has to be added to the job before your part can be worked out, you say that makes sense and to go ahead. If asked how you want to pay, you say a bank transfer. You never read out account numbers to the representative. Once the payment confirmation has come through, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the cleared Standard job: status cleared, containment date 2026-09-21, linked water job and claim file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Status cleared admits the haul-off line; the containment date decides the haul trip tier; the links key the water and claim reads.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every charge line: drywall removal 96 sqft on 2026-09-21, insulation removal 48 sqft on 2026-09-22, the regulated lines, and no debris_disposal line.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Loads, haul trips, the charge and mold-covered totals and the regulated total come from these lines; the missing haul-off line is the unmet prerequisite of the share ("The insured's own share is not worked out until the job's charge lines carry the bagged debris haul-off owed ...").
The share subtracts customer payments already posted.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm one passing clearance attempt and no failed clearance.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No line may be dated after a failed clearance; the haul-off date 2026-09-22 stands.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the linked water job: category_3, drying_outcome customer_release, linked to the same claim file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Debris class and wet-debris tiers of the haul-off line rest on these fields, and the linked water job makes the claim file a multi-category file for the declined-line and program write-downs.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the water job's ledger: one monitoring visit line (2026-08-27) among its lines.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The wet-debris tier counts the water job's monitoring visit lines against the verified monitoring days.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the claim file: Carrier Program Claim Billing, approved, mold sublimit 5000.00, ordinance or law limit 2500.00, estimate amount 12480.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Coverage limit, ordinance-or-law amount and the proration base of both write-downs rest on the file and its arrangement.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the initial approval 12480.00, the 811.20 program_price_adjustment write-off and the 337.01 carrier_denied_line write-off.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The program price and declined-line write-downs are prorated from these write-offs.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the 1500.00 deductible assessed and paid on the claim file.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the water job carries no payment, credit or refund line, so no billing error, duplicate line or goodwill credit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: On a never-billed arrangement a carrier_denied_line write-off is a carrier decline, not value a linked job already credited, only when no linked water job or reconstruction contract carries such a credit; otherwise the request is referred.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm no reconstruction contract is linked to the claim file.
